reviews.name: Liudmila Aiushinova
reviews.text:
Excellent Asian restaurant! We really enjoyed the soybean salad fresh and perfectly balanced. The breaded shrimp were crispy on the outside and juicy inside. I also highly recommend the veal bao, absolutely delicious.
The staff was very attentive and friendly, and the service was top-notch. Everything was at a high level. This place has become our family’s favorite restaurant, and we will definitely be coming back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback! We look forward to welcoming you again soon

reviews.name: Carol C
reviews.text: First time here for dinner. My overall rating was 3 stars. Food was good and at right temperature. As another reviewer mentioned, at a Chinese/Japanese restaurant you would at least expect to see an Asian working. None here or at least not when I visited. Waitress and hostess were superb. Loved the decoration and that all staff were dressed in oriental attire. A little pricey for the amount of food ordered and didn't quite like that after 4pm we could not place 1/2 orders especially when we wanted to try several dishes. Lastly, I was surprised to get the bill and an 18% gratuity was automatically added for our small party of 2. I expect this in parties of 6 or more but for 2, I think it's not fair.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback! We kindly ask you to leave your contact details in a direct message so we can reach out and ask a few questions to resolve the issue for your next visit. Looking forward to seeing you again! Best Regards, Dragon Garden Family Restaurant.

reviews.name: Bek Hovhannisyan
reviews.text:
Absolutely loved my experience at Dragon Garden! Everything was on the highest level — from the food to the service and the atmosphere. The dishes were incredibly flavorful, beautifully presented, and clearly made with high-quality ingredients.

The staff was friendly, professional, and very attentive. This place truly stands out among Asian Fusion restaurants. Highly recommended — I will definitely be coming back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback! We look forward to welcoming you again soon

reviews.name: Lulu Vasquez
reviews.text:
We came in to celebrate my husband’s birthday and we were a little confused when we walked in.

By the name of the restaurant I knew it was Asian food as they offer Chinese dishes and Japanese dishes however the staff are not Asian.

It felt more like it was an Armenian restaurant with both staff and most of their customers being Armenian. (Not that it matters) We are a blended family Mexican and Armenian. Anyway, we proceed to order and every dish was absolutely delicious. The service was great but to top it off the manager came over introduced himself and sent over a complimentary dessert.

Will definitely be back since we really enjoyed this new restaurant in our town.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your feedback! We look forward to welcoming you again soon

reviews.name: Radio CF
reviews.text:
Dragon Garden in Glendale is truly one of the best spots in its category. The atmosphere is stylish and welcoming, with great attention to detail. The staff is professional, attentive, and efficient — you can feel the quality of service right away.
The food is excellent: fresh ingredients, beautiful presentation, and great flavor. Everything feels well thought out and consistent.
Perfect place for a relaxed dinner or a night out with friends. Highly recommend — definitely coming back.

reviews.text: Had a great dining experience at Family Dragon Garden restaurant . The atmosphere is very nice. Cozy, and welcoming. Perfect for a relaxed evening. The staff was genuinely friendly and attentive, which made everything feel enjoyable. Food was delicious, especially the veal with vegetables and the shrimp bao. Both were full of flavor and beautifully prepared. I'll definitely be back, and next time it will for sure be with my whole family. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: If you're looking for some Authentic Chinese Food, this isn't the place for you. There's nothing wrong with it being a fusion cuisine, so don't get me wrong. The first thing I've noticed was the team of greaters that met us, then I've looked around and found not one Chinese staff. Again, nothing wrong with that but when you say CHINESE Restaurant, you expect someone there to be East Asian that serves Chinese food. The food is not bad but not the traditional Chinese food you'd think they'd serve since it's fusion. But on the upside… ARMEN is wonderful and so accommodating. I give him an A+.

title: Din Tai Fung 鼎泰豐
description: Modern Glendale outpost of a Taiwanese chain known for its handmade soup dumplings & Chinese fare.
openingHoursBusinessConfirmationText: Confirmed by this business 10 weeks ago

updatesFromCustomers.text: Very delicious food, nice window in the galleria to watch over while the dumpling makers are doing efficiently their job

reviews.name: Alex Cruz
reviews.text:
This place was good! I would go back. The tofu noodles were delicious! Cucumber salad was pretty good & the fried shrimp noodle was yummy! They are known for their soup dumplings & unfortunately the batch I had literally had Harley any liquid in them at all, they were super dry on the inside & out. Maybe just an odd batch. The ginger they give out in the beginning is super potent & tasty! Atmosphere was super cool. Service was good & I enjoyed seeing the chefs roll the dumplings through the viewing window.

Was not expecting this place to be in the middle of the mall! Also the wait was maybe 20 min and online it said 2 hours

I would give it another shot! 🥟

reviews.name: Steven James
reviews.text: Outstanding dumplings and such a fresh and delicious experience! Our waiter was knowledgeable and so attentive it really helped enhance the experience. I think my best bite was the shrimp pork spicy wontons, the chili sauce was subtle but with a kick while offering a big bite with large pieces of shrimp. Next time I’d skip the shao mai, they’re presentable but offer very limited taste, especially if familiar with shao mai. I always say over order and a perfect option for groups of 2-4 since everything is sharing. Loved that you can now join waitlist remotely and even reservations! Also this restaurant is in a mall, not close to any of the parking lots, we just parked on the street and walked a few blocks to avoid that mall.

reviewContext.Parking options: Paid street parking, Free parking garage
reviewContext.Parking: In the galleria near the Americana, parking can be a distance
reviewContext.Wheelchair accessibility: No ramps or stairs noticed for the main dining room, maybe a step for outside dining

reviews.name: Carlie Brosemann
reviews.text:
My favorite place to eat! The Xio long Bao is to die for and the chocolate xio long Bao is the icing on the cake. Especially when you add the salted cream to it.
Our waitresses were on top of everything. Everything came out so quickly.
Highly recommend getting a reservation.

reviewContext.Recommended dishes: Crab and Kurobuta Pork Xiao Long Bao, Cucumber Salad, Steamed Broccoli with Garlic Cloves, Garlic Green Beans, Pork Fried Rice

reviews.name: Denny
reviews.text: I have to say service and atmosphere of the restaurant is pleasing but the food is genuinely overhyped and overpriced, everything tasted the same, there was nothing really special about the food, the dumplings and other menu items taste similar to other restaurants. The fried rice was fairly too greasy and bland. Overall I’d give the experience a 7.5/10 but food 3/10

reviewContext.Group size: 2 people, Suitable for all group sizes

reviews.name: Aaliyah S
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (5/5)

We came into Din Tai Fung around 12–12:30 PM and got lucky with perfect timing. Even though this location is huge with tons of indoor and outdoor seating, it wasn’t very busy when we arrived. No wait at all, and there were seats available at the bar, so we walked right in and sat down.

This was our first time at this location (we’ve been to many others), and it did not disappoint. David was our server/bartender and he was super friendly and attentive the whole time.

Food came out quickly and everything was amazing classic Din Tai Fung consistency. Every dish we ordered was great, and we even took some home. You can always count on the food being solid here, which is why I love this place.

By the time we were leaving, a line had started to form and it was getting busy, so we definitely hit it at the right time. Overall, a great experience and always a go-to spot.

reviewContext.Recommended dishes: Cucumber Salad, Soup, Sauce, Noodle Soup, Mochi
reviewContext.Seating type: Indoor dining area, Bar area, Outdoor patio / terrace, Booth seating, Counter seating
reviewContext.Parking: Parking is in the garage no fee for parking due to it being in the mall.

reviews.name: Yaz
reviews.text: The food was amazing, this is my first time here. My friends brought me for my birthday and I loved everything I tried. We had the chicken fried noodles, the xianlongbao (AMAZING). I also love the spicy chicken wontons. The service wasn’t the best , our waiter barely came to ask if we needed anything. Other than that it was great.

reviewContext.Recommended dishes: Shrimp Fried Rice, Pork Chop Fried Rice, Spicy Wontons, Long Bao, Garlic Green Beans

reviews.name: Marina B
reviews.text:
Went to Din Tai Fung at Glendale Galleria and it was exactly what you expect — consistent, clean, and satisfying.

The Xiao Long Bao are always the star. Perfectly pleated, delicate wrappers, rich flavorful broth inside. You bite carefully and it’s that warm, comforting soup moment every time.

We also ordered the noodles — simple, light, and balanced. Nothing overly heavy, just clean flavors done right. The cucumber salad on the side was refreshing with a little kick, which balanced everything well.

The space is modern and calm, service is efficient, and food comes out quickly. It’s one of those places you go when you want something reliable that always hits.

Still one of the best spots for dumplings in LA.

reviews.name: Victoria Stewart
reviews.text:
After what seems like forever, I finally got to try Din Tai Fung.
I'l list what we ordered and give a review at the end! Brace yourselves:
Matcha milk tea. Amaretto sour. Cucumber salad. Pork Xiao Long Bao. Chicken fried rice. Bok Choy. Garlic green beans. Noodles with spicy sauce. And lastly, the chocolate & mochi Xiao long bao w/ cream sauce. I won't lie. I went in with no expectations solely because it is so popular. I was worried it might be overhyped, but I was wrong. Everything was so delicious. The chocolate mochi was my favorite though and a must get.

The restaurant itself is beautiful, and our waitress is so friendly, and so bubbly, I would love to have her again on my next visit. They blew me away & per my friends it’s consistent. So do with that information what you will, but I say it's worth the visit!

reviews.name: Janette Guerrero
reviews.text:
1st time experience was a 10/10. Love everything location, food, drinks 😁 and dessert 😋OMG so delicious chocolate Buns!! 🤤😋 I believe the wait is worth everything!!! ❤️😜 You do in this place, it can be celebration a special occasion, fun family time or just bc is a very nice place. Love the website pictures 😍 very helpful ordering food. Food price reasonable 😉👍
Now, special thanks to our female server Gesselle she was super friendly and helpful and made this experience ☺️ the best Thank you 🙏 so much!!! I would send would go back and try different fishes 💯

reviewContext.Recommended dishes: Shrimp Fried Rice, Garlic Green Beans

reviews.name: Cori Hirashima-Boettger (Blingbling)
reviews.text: Hello friends! This is the third Din Tai Fung I’ve visited—first in Oregon, then Washington, and now LA. All of them are consistently good, but I’ve noticed each location shines with certain dishes. Here in LA, the pork fried rice stands out as the best I’ve had—so tender, flavorful, and absolutely memorable! Service has been excellent at every location as well—welcoming, friendly, and attentive.

reviews.name: Jim Drake
reviews.text: Wow!!! Went to celebrate a graduation from fire academy! Had a group of 10 for lunch. They were accommodating and friendly.  The food was excellent as was the service.  I have heard about this place for years and are so glad we went. We will definitely be return customers. Spicy dumplings, noodles,  and chocolate dumplings were delicious and I would highly recommend.  Honestly we didnt have anything I wouldn't order again!!!

reviewContext.Recommended dishes: Cucumber Salad, Spicy Wontons, Noodle Soup, Kurobuta Pork, Garlic Green Beans, Pork Fried Rice

reviews.name: DragonDunut4421 Dunut
reviews.text: I think the atmosphere and the service of the place is great and may warrant a fancy get up. I must warn this place is quite expensive for what I think, is lack luster. The food it self, is above okay at best. I’ve tried a few dumpling places and they all taste too doughy. Even if that is personal preference, I think the food does lack any complexity. Referring to placing like Pick Up sticks, I think it’s night and day difference in pricing, complexity, and overall value for the food.  The famous dumplings and soup dumplings are also okay, they don’t have an inherent complexity and its simplicity is too basic to say much about it. As I said similar to another similar place, I think the Costco dumplings are better and way more cost effective for the prices. The desert dumplings were good, with a nice wake milk chocolate inside. I think you should check this place out to see if it’s your cup of tea. I would also highly recommend you try the Costco dumplings or simply visit pick up sticks to reference the complexity I talk about in these reviews (Not sponsored).

reviews.name: Bougie Corner
reviews.text:
It was both my daughter and my first time eating at this restaurant. We both had been wanting to try it, and finally had the opportunity over the weekend (Saturday). The wait can be intense depending on the day and time you get there. We arrived pretty late in the day, around 3 I would say. We waited about 40 minutes. Which didn’t seem too long because we walked around the mall shopping.

The service was fast, and the food was delicious. I tried a variety of foods. My favorite was the dumplings. My daughter really liked the baby back pork. Depending on the type of noodles, the flavor can be different. Chicken, the flavor was bland, but with their sauce to the broth, your meal will be delicious.

Next time we go, we will try their dessert. We heard good things about their desserts.

reviews.name: Lin Cheng
reviews.text: The best soup buns  ( pork dumplings) and  always love their egg fried rice with pork chop. The hot and sour soup   is also excellent.

reviews.name: Marine Marine
reviews.text: We enjoyed the atmosphere, food and service very much. One of our favorite places to go for any special occasion. Highly recommend this restaurant. We were very pleased with all aspects.

title: Sasabune Glendale
description: High-end Japanese spot serving sushi in traditional preparations within straightforward digs.
address: 101 N Brand Blvd UNIT 220, Glendale, CA 91203

reviews.name: Nana's Gathering Urbanbotany
reviews.text:
This was a Japanese restaurant my husband and I discovered by surprise — and it was such a wonderful find. It’s very quiet; we sat down around 5 PM. They have some special items on their menu, and every dish is beautifully crafted. The sashimi is a must-order. For dessert, we tried the “Magic Grape” — it felt whimsical and unexpected!

The overall atmosphere is perfect for a date or a celebration. The restaurant is located inside an office building, so you might have to look a bit carefully because the signage outside isn’t very obvious.

Highly recommended — this is definitely a place I would return to. I really love all the thoughtful details in their service, even their tableware has a sense of aesthetics and design.

reviews.name: Elsa Bonson
reviews.text: This place was amazing. Our chef and waiter were both very attentive and super nice. The atmosphere was calm and welcoming and the food was really good. We did the omakase. Their desserts are amazing too!! Worth every penny.

reviewContext.Parking options: Free parking garage, Paid parking garage

reviews.name: Isaac Gottesman
reviews.text:
Dining at Sasabune Glendale was nothing short of extraordinary. From the very first bite, the omakase meal felt like a story unfolding — a journey across the sea, where each course revealed another chapter of flavors, textures, and artistry. Every piece of fish was pristine, each preparation balanced and intentional, and the flow of the meal built a sense of anticipation and wonder.

What makes the experience even more special is its surprising location. Tucked inside a mall, right next to a California Pizza Kitchen, you’d never guess such a world-class omakase experience could be hidden here. But once you sit down and the first dish arrives, you know you’ve discovered something truly unique.

Sasabune Glendale is not just a restaurant — it’s an unforgettable adventure for anyone who loves sushi at its highest level.

reviews.name: Peter Bonamici
reviews.text:
5 Star Dining Experience and Freshest of Sashami. Great Value on the Happy Hour Menu!

I’m not used to “upscale sushi” or I guess authentic really. The place really caught me off guard by how nice it was and how impeccable the service is from start to finish. They give you a little warmed wet towel to clean your hands when you walk in, it was a nice touch.

I cannot stress how much the happy hour menu made it easy for me. It was a very fair price for what I received and was extremely filling, I got a plate of sashimi to start, 7 sushi pieces, a crab hand roll, oysters and mussels, and a Sapporo beer to wash it down. Everything was delicious and high quality.

Although a little hard to find and nestled between a loud Olive Garden, it was such a nice hidden surprise, would definitely go back to support more!

reviews.name: amit
reviews.text: What a wonderful place! On the pricier side, but definitely worth it. My friend and I went for the Omakase meal and it was an exceptional experience. The service was fast and great, and the food was delicious and authentic. You can tell the people working care about their craft. They were generous and nice to us. Would definitely come again!

reviewContext.Group size: 2 people, 3-4 people, Suitable for all group sizes

reviews.name: Summer is Live
reviews.text:
This is the best and freshest sushi in LA. Truly a hidden gem. My friend and I did the $200 omakase and it was honestly worth every penny.

I loved the anago, toro, crab, oyster, uni!! And the matcha dessert 🤤

Great service and high quality Japanese food! I’ll definitely be back, thank you Chef!!

Easy to park since they validate!

reviews.name: Fernando Roldan
reviews.text:
I was at this restaurant last night...SASABUNE GLENDALE CA.

I'm appalled by how racist people are. I arrived with a person with a disability, and a woman came out to ask us, "Do you have a table reserved?" "No."

Then she went to the man who prepares the food and asked if we could come in. He said yes, because they gave us a table. An empty place...there was only one other table occupied. But before we took the table, the waitress asked us if we wanted to see the prices first and see if we could order...and if we knew how to eat sushi. We said yes, and we sat down.

We ordered three different things for the two of us. But surprise! They only give you one tiny piece of each and charge $11, $13, or $15 for that tiny piece.
I didn't even eat. I paid $83 and gave a tip, but my question is...  Because there are still RACIST people who think we don't know how to eat... or that we can't afford it. They're demanding when it comes to getting into this place, but they're MISERABLE WITH THE FOOD.

We've been to very good restaurants in Burbank and Glendale where the service is much better.

It hurt to have wasted my money on those people and that MISERABLE food.
I went out for pizza right away... and what KIND people... Polite... and cheerful. POSITIVE people.

reviews.name: Natalia Carter
reviews.text: Sasabune Glendale is a hidden gem for sushi lovers. The service here is exceptional--attentive and knowledgeable staff make you feel right at home. The quality of the fish is outstanding, with each piece tasting incredibly fresh. The omakase experience is truly delightful, offering a perfect balance of flavors and textures that showcase the chef's expertise. Whether you're a sushi aficionado or just looking to treat yourself, Sasabune Glendale is a must-visit.

reviews.name: Robert Bogolin
reviews.text: You would never assume arguably the best omakase around Glendale would be hidden in this office building but here we are! The restaurant is small with a relaxed vibe. The service was friendly and accommodating. We had the regular omakase and it was a good amount of food! The quality was among the best I have had and certainly at this price point. I look forward to going back!

reviews.name: Masako Hida
reviews.text:
My second time omakase at Sasabune. I’ve tried multiple locations or other restaurants, but one in Glendale is the best. The location is hard to find, but if you direct to California Pizza Kitchen, they are right next to it.

We’ve ordered Japanese omakase and it was phenomenal experience. More than enough and fresh sushi and sashimi.

It’s as good as you eating sushi in Japan! It reminded us of sushi in Tsukiji in Japan. We’ll definitely come back again!!

reviewContext.Parking options: Free parking lot, Free parking garage

reviews.name: Michael Mikhjian
reviews.text: The staff at Sasabune are exceptionally friendly and accommodating, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. While the prices are on the higher side, the exceptional quality of the sushi and the meticulous attention to detail make it well worth it. This is truly authentic, top-tier sushi—an experience that leaves a lasting impression on your palate. I highly recommend for your next special sushi occasion!

reviews.name: Sharleen Mariano
reviews.text:
If you like raw fish and omakase- this is the one of THE best sushi in LA! Come with an open mind and palate, it’s so good! The fish is premier and MELTS in your mouth

If omakase is out of your budget, come during lunch time!!

reviews.name: Cc
reviews.text: This place is for hardcore sushi lovers. They don’t have the conventional dishes like tempura, teriyaki chicken, and so forth. Instead, they focus on sushi. Mind you, it’s good, but it gets pretty pricey when you try to get full from it. The service was good, and they do validate your parking ticket. I would recommend this place if you crave for some tasty sushi.

reviews.name: Nikki
reviews.text:
Sasabune is a delightful sushi spot, and my top picks were definitely the tuna and salmon selections. The omakase experience was mostly outstanding, but I must admit that the mango dressing on one of the sushi pieces didn't quite hit the mark for me. However, it's important to note that I'm personally not a fan of mango dressing on sashimi in general.

Despite that small hiccup, I thoroughly enjoyed my dining experience, and I would absolutely consider coming back for more. It's worth mentioning that dining at Sasabune might require a bit of a splurge, as I remember the cost being on the higher side, around $100 or more.

If you're a sushi lover and willing to indulge in a top-notch dining experience, Sasabune is definitely a place to check out. Just be prepared for a fantastic meal and consider skipping the mango dressing if it's not your cup of tea!

reviews.name: Shirley H
reviews.text: The food is great. You can tell all their fish/ingredients are fresh. However, we felt rushed by our server during our dining process. The price is definitely on the expensive side. They also charged for hot tea. We didn’t think we’ve been notified with that before we “asked for” the hot tea. Also, the serve ware they used don’t seem to match their price point. They look like some cheap plates.

title: Jincook
description: Small pub with traditional dishes like short rib or Japanese favorites like katsu.

reviews.name: Jason Yau
reviews.text:
Visited Jin Cook in Glendale today for some authentic korean soul food. Upon entering the store we noticed all the authentic decor at the entrance. The restaurant had a good amount of tables and we were seated immediately. Shortly after it began to fill up and it was a full house.

My friends and I ordered the braised beef short ribs (galbi jjim), seafood pancake, chicken noodle soup (kal guk soo), steamed dumplings and brisket hot stone. The braised short rib was tender and fall off the bone. The onions, rice cake, pumpkin and potato were soft and soaked up all the sauce that it came with giving us a punch of flavor with every bite. Would recommend eating it with rice to not waste any sauce. The cheese was evenly distributed on top and torched at the table. The seafood pancake had crispy edges and chunks of seafood in every bite. The steamed dumplings were pretty standard with the pork filling. I liked how thin the wrapper was and meat was flavorful. The chicken noodle soup was perfect for the chilly day we had. It was nice and warm which helped warm up our stomach before the meal. The noodles were nice and chewy while chicken was shredded and soft. The brisket hot stone reminded us of a gyudon. The meat was flavorful and the garnishes it came with gave it plenty of texture and depth.

The staff was attentive and came around to check in on us. They refilled our waters and brought us more of the banchan. The sides included kimchi, radish, spinach and pickled onions which accompanied the meal well.

Parking can be found in the back or on the street. They are located off Brand right across from Porto’s and a couple blocks away from The Americana. Perfect to go shopping then head over to eat or if you want do dine late at night. They serve alcohol and other non alcoholic drinks as well depending on your mood.

reviews.name: Amy Keor
reviews.text:
Jincook is Korean soul food. Everything was amazing the flavors were rich and satisfying. I still can’t stop thinking about how good the food was. I absolutely loved the steamed pork dumplings and the seasoned dumplings. All of the dishes and side dishes feel traditional and also seem very healthy.

We also ordered the spicy tofu soup (soondubu jjigae), which I had never tried before, and it was delicious. We ordered bibim noodles with plenty of chicken and vegetables  it was refreshing, almost like a chicken salad, and so tasty. I will definitely order it again next time.

We also tried the Korean galbi and Korean garlic soy chicken, and everything was great. I was really happy that at Jincook you can enjoy both spicy flavors and comforting, mild flavors. Overall, it was a very satisfying experience

reviews.name: Rommel Jimenez
reviews.text: If you want some Korean soul food then this place is for you. The decor takes you back in time, everything is so clean and the service is super friendly. Great to see more Korean restaurants in the city. We ordered Sweet potato cheese curry katsu , Brisket hot stone , Traditional pork soup, Garlic soy chicken, Bibimbap hot stone, Mushroom japchae, and Marinated dumpling. I definitely recommend getting the hot stone dishes since I love how it crisps up the rice. Definitely one of my top favorites that’s not AYCE Korean food. Plenty of pay parking in the back.

reviewContext.Parking options: Paid parking lot, Paid street parking

reviews.name: Giovanni
reviews.text:
It’s easily one of the best Korean restaurants I’ve had. The portions are generous, everything is packed with flavor, and you can really taste the quality in each dish.

The spicy fried chicken and the pork ribs were absolute standouts, both were incredibly good.

The staff was extremely kind and welcoming, which made the experience even better. The atmosphere is beautiful with a traditional touch that adds a lot of charm.

Honestly, you can go there with your eyes closed.

reviews.name: Diana Chang
reviews.text:
This is the kind of meal you crave when you want something warm, filling, and full of flavor🫶🏼

The Bulgogi Hot Stone arrived sizzling, with tender beef and rice that gets crispy as you eat. The Sweet Potato Cheese Katsu surprised us with its sweetness and gooey center, while the Pork Katsu was perfectly breaded and juicy.

The Korean BBQ Short Rib was deeply savory and comforting, and the Korean Pancake added that crispy, shareable bite every table needs. Pair it all with a Soju Highball, and it’s comfort food done right.

reviews.name: Iman
reviews.text: It was packed at 730 on a Friday but we got a table for 2 quickly. Ordered the bulgogi, chicken Katsu, and the pancake - all of which were so good! Perfect spot during the unusually chilly weather.

reviews.name: V Bee
reviews.text: Our family loves coming here, sometimes we forget it’s down the street!! Service and food is 100% all the time, we love the bulgogi and the fried dumplings ommggg sooo good! I’m sure everything else on the menu is good will definitely be coming back!

reviewContext.Parking options: Paid parking lot, Paid street parking

reviews.name: 李佳怡
reviews.text:
This hidden gem in Glendale feels like stepping into an old-school Korean eatery—simple, cozy, and packed with charm. The no-reservation, walk-in-only policy means it’s always bustling, especially during dinner hours, but the wait is so worth it.

The staff is friendly, and the vibe feels like a classic spot you’d find in Seoul. Everything is served fresh, with generous portions and no fuss. Perfect for a casual night out without the hassle of heading to K-Town. If you’re looking for authentic Korean comfort food in a relaxed setting, this is the place!

reviews.name: Nancy Abigail
reviews.text:
On November 18, 2025, we visited Jincook, a Korean restaurant. We really had a wonderful experience. Our server, May, was exceptional—very attentive, friendly, always smiling, with good attitude since nothing ever seemed to be a problem for her. Truly outstanding service!
We ordered the hot beef bibimbap, and it was delicious and flavorful. We requested the sauce and the kimchi on the side, and they happily accommodated us without any hesitation.
The place itself is cozy and inviting. Overall, I highly recommend this restaurant for its great food, excellent service, and the flexible, welcoming and positive attitude of both the server and the kitchen staff.

reviews.name: Rockstar Eater
reviews.text:
More like a 4.5. For a Korean restaurant in Glendale, Jincook is as legit as it gets. This restaurant has the awesome interior vibes that's much like being in a traditional Korean environment but with nice modern touches. And for the food, the menu mixes traditional Korean and modern Korean dishes to make for a delicious and fun experience. For sure, get the galbi-jimm, because it is huge, tasty, and they even light it on fire. The chicken katsu was also pretty good. It's one of my go-tos in an Asian restaurant if I don't know what else to get. But the biggest surprise to me was the soon tofu, which was very flavorful and melt in your mouth.

The banchan selections are also very traditional. A bit on the sweet side, but it's not entirely my focus since I gotta concentrate on the big entrees. There are a few locations of Jin Cook around, but if you're looking for in the Glendale area, then you're in luck. I think it's especially great for small groups, so that you can enjoy that braised short rib dish, and even their pork belly dish (which hopefully I can get next time).

reviews.name: Jasmin A
reviews.text: Delicious food!! Highly recommend the chicken katsu curry, bulgogi hot stone, and mushroom japchae.

reviews.name: Koco Nikki
reviews.text:
My friends and I went here a few weeks ago, around 9pm.
In a pinch and late night, this spot is great to get Korean food.

The venue decor was a homage to traditional Korean decor!

Service was great, our food runner and server were very attentive.

The menu had a variety of Korean dishes, in addition to Japanese and Korean fusion dishes. I got the beef bone soup with rice, my friends ordered : LA Korean BBQ Beef Rib, spicy tofu stew, marinated, dumpling, and two other soup items... I forgot which ones.
The flavors were very homelike, and cozy. The only thing that I was sad about - they didn't have sea salt or perilla seeds. However, that is more of a personal choice, not really something to criticize a business over.

reviews.name: B L
reviews.text: Hands down, Jincook Korean restaurant is a must-visit in Glendale! The Pork Cutlet curry over rice is a game-changer - it's the best in town! The Suyuk was cooked to perfection, with just the right amount of seasoning. And the Mushroom japchae? Wow, every bite was bursting with truffle flavor! But what really sets Jincook apart is the decor - it's like stepping into a traditional Korean setting. The attention to detail is impressive, and it definitely adds to the overall dining experience. If you're a fan of Korean food, or just looking for a delicious meal, Jincook is the place to go. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: David Su
reviews.text: The food is so great and tasty. The serving size is enough for two or three persons. They have their own ideas to make traditional foods creative.

reviews.name: Fang Phattha
reviews.text: One of the best Korean restaurants I’ve been to. We went after they extended the opening hours to late night. The queue is long since early evening but fortunately we didn’t have to wait so long. There are traditional dishes and fusion dishes. The shitake mushroom and the mushroom curry were my favorites! My friends really like rose toekbokki. They took the remaining thick soup to eat in the next meal. There were only 2 servers in a full house restaurant so they worked hard and it sometimes took time to get attention but food serving was pretty quick. Parking was metered and it looked full but we did find a spot.
